summary: Enhance your skills with our expert-led Quality Assurance Training Course. Learn essential QA techniques and tools to boost your career.
lede: Preventing defects through process design and verification is central to quality assurance. For experienced quality, compliance, operations and supply chain professionals, this course builds practical skills in designing quality management systems, interpreting control charts, investigating non-conformances, planning internal and supplier audits, and prioritizing process risks with FMEA.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for experienced professionals responsible for maintaining and improving organizational standards across diverse sectors.
audience: Customer Success Leads using quality data
modules: Statistical Process Control and Data Analytics
Root Cause Analysis and CAPA Management
prerequisites: Participants should have at least three years of experience in a quality, compliance, or operational management role. Familiarity with basic statistical concepts and a working knowledge of the ISO 9001 standard is recommended. No prior coding or advanced mathematical background is required, as all technical tools will be taught during the program.
